selection_rules.eligible: Exact brand totals, all powertrains, excluding TESLA, complete selection window, mean monthly count >= 1000; no aggregates or model rows
selection_rules.C: Minimum sample coefficient of variation on selection window; tie: lexical brand name
selection_rules.D: Highest mean monthly count among remaining eligible brands; tie: lexical brand name
selection_rules.no_eligible_brand: Report blocked; do not weaken rules after viewing recovery
selection_rules.no_complete_selection_window: Report blocked; do not select on a different window without a reviewed plan revision

unknown_layout_policy: Fail closed; explicit reviewed parser profile required
missing_data_policy: No fill, interpolation or synthetic extension
